question: When is the minor examination for slot K courses?
sources: AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Examination); AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Slot System)
answer:
The minor examination for K courses is scheduled to take place on 17 September 2026, Thursday, from 02:00 PM to 04:00 PM. 

Source: AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Examination); AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Slot System)
